top_violation_types.title: Space and Equipment - Age-appropriate Seating, Tables (26 TAC §744.2051(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child 5 years of age fell and fractured their arm after climbing onto a high backless metal stool to play an arcade game.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Intervene when necessary (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the director did not intervene to stop a parent from talking to another child in care to correct the child's behavior.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §746.3701(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A large unmounted fan was accessible to children. This was corrected during the inspection when the director turned off the fan and removed it from the area.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver allowed an infant to fall asleep in a restrictive device (swing) for approximately twelve minutes before removing the infant from the device and placing the infant in a crib.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping with a bottle.

top_violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.
